title: Executive Assistant to CEO and Executive Operations Coordinator
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO and Executive Operations Coordinator

**Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Location:** India, Remote Initially  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote initially, with potential hybrid or in-office work in Hyderabad in 2027-2028  
**Business Hours:** U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Approximately 7:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST during U.S. standard time, and 6:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST during U.S. daylight saving time.  
**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer

About the Role

We are a growing U.S.-based IT services and technology reseller with back-office operations and support teams in India and Latin America.

We are hiring a highly organized, mature, and confidential Executive Assistant to support the CEO directly. This role combines executive support, meeting management, project coordination, leadership follow-up, and CEO office operations.

The successful candidate will help the CEO stay focused on high-value priorities by managing schedules, preparing meetings, tracking decisions, following up on commitments, organizing documents, and coordinating key company projects.

This is a high-trust role. You will have access to confidential business, financial, personnel, client, leadership, and limited personal information. Discretion, good judgment, strong English, and reliability are essential.

Key ResponsibilitiesCEO Support

* Manage the CEO’s calendar, meeting schedule, reminders, and priorities
* Coordinate internal and external meetings across U.S., India, Peru, and other time zones
* Prepare meeting agendas, pre-reads, background information, and follow-up materials
* Review and organize incoming requests, emails, documents, and meeting invitations
* Flag urgent items, decisions, risks, and deadlines requiring CEO attention
* Draft professional emails, messages, summaries, and follow-up communication for CEO review
* Coordinate travel, appointments, and limited personal logistics when assigned

Leadership Meeting Management

* Support weekly leadership meetings, revenue meetings, strategy meetings, and one-on-one meetings
* Record decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and blockers
* Maintain a leadership action tracker
* Follow up with department heads before deadlines
* Escalate overdue, blocked, or high-risk items to the CEO
* Create concise meeting summaries and send them to appropriate attendees

Executive Operations and Project Coordination

* Maintain the CEO’s master priority list and company transformation tracker
* Track major projects across Finance, Operations, HR, Sales, Service Delivery, compliance, systems, hiring, and consultants
* Maintain project status, owners, deadlines, deliverables, risks, and next steps
* Coordinate meetings, documents, and deliverables with consultants, vendors, contractors, and internal leaders
* Ensure action items from consultants and leadership are tracked through completion
* Prepare simple decision briefs for the CEO that summarize the issue, recommendation, cost, risk, owner, and deadline

Document and Information Management

* Organize confidential CEO, leadership, consultant, finance, HR, legal, and project documents
* Maintain secure folders, meeting notes, decision logs, action trackers, and executive dashboards
* Ensure documents are stored in approved company systems
* Maintain version control and easy access to current documents
* Protect all confidential information and follow company security requirements

Hiring and Administrative Coordination

* Coordinate candidate interviews, leadership interviews, consultant calls, and follow-up communication
* Track candidate status, interview feedback, screening information, and next steps
* Support contract, NDA, invoice, and approval routing
* Assist with creating presentations, meeting notes, reports, and executive documents
* Coordinate with Operations, HR, Finance, Sales, and Service Delivery as needed

Required Skills and Experience

* 4 or more years of experience supporting a CEO, founder, executive, senior leader, or business owner
* Experience working in an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff Assistant, Executive Operations, or Project Coordinator role
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong organization, follow-up, prioritization, and time-management skills
* Ability to work independently with limited direction
* Strong judgment and ability to handle confidential information
* Experience supporting meetings, calendars, executive communications, and action tracking
* Advanced Microsoft 365 skills, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint or OneDrive
* Experience using project-management, CRM, HR, or finance platforms such as Zoho, ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems
* Comfortable working U.S. Eastern Time business hours
* Stable internet connection and professional remote-work environment

Preferred Experience

* Experience supporting a CEO in an IT services, MSP, technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, consulting, or professional services company
* Experience coordinating teams across the United States, India, and Latin America
* Experience creating executive dashboards, reports, and PowerPoint presentations
* Experience working with Finance, HR, Sales, Operations, and Service Delivery leaders
* Experience supporting a founder-led or rapidly growing company

Success Measures

Success in this role means:

* The CEO enters meetings prepared with the right information
* Every meeting has documented decisions, owners, and deadlines
* Leadership action items are tracked and followed up consistently
* The CEO has a clear daily and weekly view of priorities, risks, decisions, and overdue items
* Consultants, department leaders, and project owners receive timely follow-up
* Important work does not get lost across emails, chats, meetings, and documents
* Confidential information remains secure and properly organized
* The CEO spends more time on strategy, growth, clients, partnerships, and major decisions

Application Instructions

Please include the following in your application:

* Your experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive.
* Your experience working U.S. Eastern Time business hours from India.
* The tools you have used for calendar management, project tracking, meeting notes, and executive reporting.
* An example of how you tracked action items across multiple department heads.
* Your current salary, expected salary, and notice period.
* Your English proficiency rating from 1 to 10.
* A short written example of a professional follow-up email you would send after a leadership meeting.

Pay: ₹28,000.00 - ₹37,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

title: Senior Consultant
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Position Title:** Senior Consultant, RTO

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment:** Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**Main responsibilities**


RTO Candidate will be responsible for \-

* Managing day\-to\-day technical activities of the Real Time Optimisation (RTO) and Data Reconciliation \& Yield Accounting team for deliveries of projects to clients in domestic \& global locations in various Chemicals, Oil \& Gas (COG) viz. the Refinery \& Hydrocarbon industries and the Fossil fuel Power generation industries
* Working with its end clients and ensure quality \& timely deliveries to the assigned projects with full client satisfaction.
* Technical planning to deliver project demands based on local/regional forecasts
* Participating in pre\-sales activities (Validation of manhour estimates, proposals review etc.) as and when required.
* Meeting company defined KPI’s applicable to the team.

 **Essential skills and experience required**

* Candidates should have strong chemical Engineering fundamentals.
* Should have total of 8\+ years of experience out of which he/she should have hands on experience on Steady state \&/or dynamic simulations for at least 3\+ years.
* For remaining experience, Hydrocarbon plant operations experience will be considered relevant.
* Proficiency in implementation of simulations Models (using commercial RTO software i.e., ROMeo, etc.), Yield accounting, APC will be preferred,
* Good problem solving, communication, interpersonal and team playing skills

 **Qualification:**

* B Tech/M Tech Chemical Engineering as a minimum.

**Services at AVEVA**


Our dynamic global team of 700\+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting\-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.


You’ll also be joining an award\-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.


Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

 **India Benefits include:**


Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support


It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

 **Hybrid working**


We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

 **Hiring process**


Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process

 **About AVEVA**


AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

  

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

  

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

  

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.
